{{Top}}
[[File:LataraScarf-HardSell.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Latara and her scarf]]
{{Quote|Better take a scarf!|[[Shodu Warrick]], to her son Wicket|<ref name="Home is Where the Shrieks Are">{{Ewoks|Home Is Where the Shrieks Are}}</ref>}}
'''Scarves''' were accessories worn around the neck for warmth or style. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] owned scarves. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] later used scarves of various [[Color/Legends|colors]] to disguise her disfigured face when appearing in public.
